title: Incubation Recovery and Pre-Amplification PCR Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Samples are moved to a PCR strip tube prior to thermocycler step as outlined in procedure documentation

steps.title: Add recovery agent
steps.instruction: Add 125 µL of recovery agent to each sample.

steps.title: Incubate to form biphasic mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples for 2 minutes until a biphasic mixture is observed.

steps.title: Inspect biphasic mixture
steps.instruction: Visually inspect the biphasic mixture; then select “resume” in the application.

steps.title: Remove recovery agent
steps.instruction: Remove the recovery agent, leaving only a clear liquid in the wells.

steps.title: Add pre-amplification mix
steps.instruction: Add 35 µL of pre‑amplification mix to each sample.

steps.title: Transfer samples to PCR strip
steps.instruction: Transfer the samples to PCR strip tubes prior to the thermocycler step as described in the procedure documentation.
